children: rose more than 25%, marking its best intraday rally since February 2024 after posting trial data for its weight loss therapy, VK2735, which, according to Wall Street analysts, indicated a “clean” safety profile.

Data from the VK2735-102 maintenance study also demonstrated a 22% weight loss for injectable over 33 weeks and its potential in maintaining weight loss effects after switching from a weekly regimen in the induction phase to less frequent regimens in

“Tolerability came in clean, which we view as the piece that de-risks the step-down construct," Truist analyst Gregory Renza wrote with a Buy recommendation on VKTX, according to Bloomberg. The analyst expects a 30% - 40% gain for the stock from the previous close as investors react to the latest trial data for the GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist.

Leerink Partners analyst Thomas Smith, who has an Outperform rating on the stock, argued that data continues to build on VK2735’s “potentially differentiated profile.” “Safety/tolerability also appears impressively clean, with low GI-related side effects and minimal discontinuations," he added.

Morgan Stanley’s Michael Ulz viewed “data as very positive and indicative of a differentiated safety/tolerability profile as well as efficacy in both the weight loss (induction) and weight retention (maintenance) settings.”

“Safety and tolerability remained favorable in the maintenance period, with the rates of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) being comparable to placebo across all dose levels," the analyst wrote with an Overweight rating.
While highlighting positive findings in VK2735-102, Seeking Alpha analyst
continued to flag funding risks for Viking
and the increasingly crowded market for GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.
As for reasons for the rally, “I think it is a net positive,” wrote
, adding, “but there is, of course, concern about the dilution, and I think the market likely remains cognizant that there is plenty of competition out there.”

title: Viking Thera adds most since 2024 after “clean” safety data for obesity drug
